items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I went out with Dom DeLuise once... We got Class A rooms, and we just played the show... those cruises with him were very memorable

ctx.x: No. Not unless your legs are not the same length or something. Tell me about playing on the — doing the cruise work. I’ve often wondered what exactly that is like.

Well it can — if you go out with an individual, I went out with Dom DeLuise once, an excellent comedian with eight pounds of music by the way, he sings, he dances, which there’s a side of him you don’t see. He sings opera and you have to know how to play these things. And going on with a celebrity is different than being the house drummer shall we say. We got Class A rooms, and we just played the show, which left plenty of time to go ashore and plenty of time to eat, and those cruises with him were very memorable…
